scenarios.name: VIP Movement — Base Case (Mantralaya to Mumbai Airport T2)
scenarios.description: SIMULATED BASE CASE. A Z+ protected movement from Mantralaya to Mumbai Airport Terminal 2 on a Monday afternoon: along Marine Drive from Churchgate to Marine Lines, north on the Coastal Road under Malabar Hill and past Haji Ali to the Worli end, over the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, up the Western Express Highway past Kalanagar, Vakola and Vile Parle and along the Sahar Elevated Road to the T2 forecourt. Maximum-protocol closure (180 s advance, full closure), default event rates, no weather — the reference movement every other scenario generalises. Rolling holds, never a blanket freeze. Public-safety logistics only: no person is named or tracked. The convoy speed (60 km/h) and the timings are modelled assumptions; the AI proposes the plan and a named officer decides.

scenarios.name: Anant Chaturdashi Visarjan — Lalbaug to Girgaon Chowpatty, Closures and Ambulance Access
scenarios.description: FLAGSHIP. 21:30 on Anant Chaturdashi (6 Sep 2025), the last day of Ganeshotsav. Immersion processions leave Lalbaug and move at walking pace by Byculla, JJ, Nagpada and Opera House to Girgaon Chowpatty, while the Lalbaugcha Raja and Parel crowds fill Dr Ambedkar Road. The carriageway is closed in stages along the procession route (modelled as forced closures), heavy vehicles are kept off the city's roads for the day (modelled as fewer heavy-vehicle breakdowns, breakdown x0.6) and festival stalls load the kerbs (market x2.0). Ten minutes in, an ambulance (108) on an emergency call asks for a green corridor from Girgaon Chowpatty by Opera House and Nagpada to JJ Hospital, against the flow of the processions. Closure policy signal_hold at 45 s: the crowd is regulated, not stopped. Two Mumbai Traffic Police beats and the ambulance are animated (EMULATED units). Crowd loads, closure timings and speeds are modelled assumptions; the AI proposes each hold and a named officer decides.

scenarios.name: Heavy Burst at High Tide — Hindmata, King's Circle, Sion and the Subways
scenarios.description: SIMULATED monsoon emergency. A heavy burst coincides with a high tide on the Arabian Sea: the sea outfalls close and the city's known low spots flood — Hindmata, Dadar TT, Kings Circle (Gandhi Market) and Sion on Dr Ambedkar Road, with the Milan and Andheri subways shut in the western suburbs. A relief column runs Dr Ambedkar Road from Parel to Sion. Storm-water pump status is EMULATED and the tide is MODELLED; rain intensity and water depths are assumptions, not a live feed. The AI can only PROPOSE: extra dewatering pumps from BMC (1916) at King's Circle, diversions, BEST holds and an isolation request to the power utility for a live-wire hazard at Hindmata; a named officer approves or rejects each.

scenarios.name: Mithi at the Danger Mark — Kurla Evacuations, Subways Shut, SV Road Diversion

A BEST relief column moves from BKC to Kurla and onto the SCLR while BMC (1916) and the police move families to shelter. River level, rain and water depths here are SIMULATED; pump status is EMULATED; the AI proposes diversions and relief priority, a named officer decides.
